# Pulsating Earrings

Internal ID: TrinketCarapaceEitr | Type: Trinkets | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Carapace x5, Refined eitr x5, Gjall trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 65 | Effect: +25% eitr regen | Duration: 1m

# Introduction

Pulsating Earrings is a Mistlands-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 65 Adrenaline has been gained, the Pulsating Earrings will trigger automatically, providing +25% eitr regeneration for 60 seconds.

Categorias: Trinket
